name: Selvara Phase 4 by Emaar
paymentPlan: 10% Down Payment at sales launch + 70% During Construction + 20% On Handover
overview: Selvara Phase 4 marks the latest chapter in Emaar Properties’ celebrated collection, offering premium 4-bedroom villas that merge contemporary architecture with the timeless charm of equestrian living. Located within the exclusive Grand Polo Club and Resort, each villa is thoughtfully designed to provide residents with a sanctuary of sophistication, tranquility, and style.
